summary: terminal_full.py; CLI requires repository root and plan dir, optional out and slice R0-R4; executes registered commands only with repo-contained cwd; slices map to targeted tests and <slice>-green command; full validates all slice receipts, resume state, final bindings and full command IDs; requires plan state implementation-authorized plus published authorization; validates maintainer receipt plan, transition, artifact paths and hashes; validates knowledge context/freeze and permits catalog_stale only with source_refresh; validates ready non-authorizing skill-input receipt via repository validator; candidate binding hashes HEAD, binary diff, and non-generated untracked files; full pass emits immutable quick-dev implementation-complete receipt, successor on content conflict; terminal result is non-authorizing and includes contract/registry/candidate hashes, commands, selectors, failures; errors yield status fail and nonzero exit; ambiguities: contract/registry read before existence/error handling; receipt selection is latest mtime; plan arg in candidate binding unused.
